finalMessage:
`Refunder.refund` exists to return part of an earlier charge to its original transaction, enforce the remaining-charge and per-account UTC-day refund limits, and record a successful refund in the audit log. The repository traces it to **R-REFUND-ORIGINAL**, **R-REFUND-LIMIT**, and **R-AUDIT-MONEY**. [Implementation](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T1.2/repo/src/refunds.ts:66)

The direct tests are in [refunds.test.ts](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T1.2/repo/src/refunds.test.ts:48):

- **“refunds to the original transaction”** checks the gateway transaction, audit entry, and rejection of a refund larger than the remaining charge.
- **“totals refunds per account and UTC day”** checks the daily limit and its reset on the next day.

The same file’s **`checkRefundLimit`** tests cover the limit rules used by the method. The trace also lists **“Processor > appends an audit entry”** for R-AUDIT-MONEY; that test covers charges, while the refund audit assertion is in “refunds to the original transaction.” No files were changed.
